hypothesis: At least one crisis/stress filter can selectively permit frozen V11 event-level completion to 100% gross while avoiding the drawdown failure seen in V5 and improving risk-adjusted performance versus its matched unconditional completion control.
allowed_changes: F-VIXTERM exact VIX9D/VIX structural non-inversion state ratio<=1.0
F-CREDITCASH exact HYG/SHY adjusted-close 20-common-observation rising state
reuse of the already-frozen V5 event-only completion-to-100%-gross architecture
forbidden_changes: any frozen V11 parameter or target-path rule change
any VVIX or credit lookback search
any stale-tolerance, gross-target or band search
factor-driven trades between frozen V11 event dates
replacing a failed candidate after results
changing fee/slippage, leverage, financing, shorting or cash constraints
opening another retrospective factor-discovery family after this trial
selection_metric: No winner optimization. Compare each candidate against V11-CONTROL and its own matched availability ALWAYS-complete control using frozen gates.
pass_fail_gates: at least 4/7 fixed folds have candidate Sharpe >= matched-control Sharpe
max gross <=100%, min target weight >=0, no financing or negative cash
STRONG_INCREMENTAL only if admitted plus CAGR >= V11 CAGR +1.0 percentage point and Sharpe >= V11 Sharpe
follow_up_policy: This is the final retrospective factor-discovery family in the current campaign. After results are opened, no additional historical factor family, factor combination, threshold rescue, horizon change, stale-rule change, band change or gross-target change is allowed. Passing candidates may only enter separately preregistered robustness work; otherwise research returns to G4/G6/new future data.
swift_engine_entrypoint: scripts/run_final_crisis_filter_v6.py -> tools/final_crisis_filter_v6.swiftpart + immutable V3/V1 logic -> frozen V11 source run + BacktestEngine.runResearchTargetProviderStrategyWithTrace -> shared BacktestDailySimulator
expected_outputs: three matched controls and all three formal candidate metrics
same seven fixed folds, 2020+, 2022+, trade/cash/constraint/event counts
run authorization, execution Git commit, dataset/result SHA manifests
